question.text: The minimum capital commitment required from an ordinary investor in a Category III AIF is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, minimum capital commitment is Rs. 1 crore, except for Accredited Investors (carve-out). The Trap: Rs. 25 lakh is for employees/directors. Rs. 10 lakh applies to PMS. Rs. 5 crore is too high. Cross-Exam Context: Contrasts with PMS minimum of Rs. 50 lakh (XXI-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Pitch only to clients who can truly commit Rs. 1 crore without compromising liquidity.
